introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to Music Personality Test. We are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains our privacy-focused approach: we do not collect or store your personal information. All survey responses and results remain private in your browser.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.noCollectionContent: We are committed to protecting your privacy. Our music personality test operates entirely in your browser and does not collect or store any personal information on our servers.
localStorageItems: Survey responses are stored only in your browser's local storage
Language preferences are saved locally in your browser
Test results remain on your device and are never transmitted to us
No personal identifiers (name, email, phone) are collected
thirdPartyItems: Google AdSense may collect cookies and usage data for advertising purposes
We do not have access to or control over third-party data collection

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.noUsageContent: We do not use your personal information because we do not collect it.
browserProcessingItems: Survey responses are processed locally to generate your personality results
Language preferences are remembered for your convenience
All processing happens on your device - nothing is sent to our servers

thirdPartyServices.title: Third-Party Services
thirdPartyServices.googleAdsenseContent: We use Google AdSense to display advertisements. Google may use cookies and web beacons to collect information about your visits to this and other websites to provide targeted advertisements. You can opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google's Ad Settings.
thirdPartyServices.noAnalyticsContent: We do not use any analytics services or tracking tools to monitor your behavior. Your usage of our website is completely private.

cookies.title: Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.ourStorageContent: We use only local browser storage to:
ourStorageItems: Save your survey progress and results locally on your device
No tracking or analytics cookies are used by us
cookies.thirdPartyCookiesContent: Google AdSense may use cookies for advertising purposes. You can control these through your browser settings or Google's Ad Settings. Disabling cookies will not affect the core functionality of our personality test.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: Your data is secure because it never leaves your device. All survey responses and results are processed and stored locally in your browser. Since we don't collect or transmit your personal information to our servers, there is no risk of data breaches or unauthorized access to your survey responses.

userRights.title: Your Data Control
userRights.content: You have complete control over your data because it's stored locally in your browser:
controlItems: Clear your browser's local storage to delete all survey data
Your data never leaves your device, so there's nothing for us to access or delete
You can retake the test anytime without any account or registration
userRights.noTraditionalRights: Since we don't collect personal information, traditional data rights (access, correction, deletion requests) don't apply to our service.

childrenPrivacy.title: Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.content: Since we do not collect any personal information from users of any age, our service is safe for children to use. All data remains on the user's device. However, we recommend parental guidance for children under 13 when using any online service.

policyChanges.title: Changes to This Policy
policyChanges.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date at the top of this policy.
